name: England
dossier:
The England national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Three Lions, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 4 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

A golden generation desperate to finally go all the way and win their first trophy since 1966.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, England will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group L and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group L. The connection between Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Jude Bellingham - the clinical midfield who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: England are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: England's quest to bring football home takes them to North America, aiming to build on deep tournament runs.
England boast 1 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Champions (1966).
